text:
Sam: Quick sync — we need to lock down the canonical TTFT definition for the public dashboard and the perf regression checks. Current confusion: does TTFT include network queue time or only server-side decode start?

Jia: For the dashboards I think we should include server-side queue + model decode start, but exclude client networking. That way the metric reflects infra + model cost.

Priya: +1 on including server queue. Ops teams can split out a separate `client_rtt` trace if needed.

Alex: For clarity, proposed definition: `TTFT = time from request acceptance by routing layer -> time first token emitted by model runtime`. That includes routing queue and any dynamic batching wait.

Sam: That works. Can we add explicit tags: `component=router|batcher|runtime` on the trace spans so the dashboard p95 can be broken down?

Mark: Yep. infra-bot, can you confirm the trace schema change is safe?

infra-bot: deploy-check: trace-schema-v2 flagged. Backwards compatible fields `component` added. No migration needed. Safe to enable behind flag `trace_component_tag`.

Priya: Next: regression gating. Proposal: daily job that runs smoke suite vs prod-like load and checks: p95(TTFT) increase < 10% AND tok/s drop < 7% otherwise alert. Thoughts?

Jia: Those thresholds seem reasonable as a starting point. We should run for a week and collect noise levels. Also different models have different baselines — job should compare against model-specific baseline.

Sam: Agreed. Action items: 1) Jia to update dashboard docs with TTFT definition + span tags. 2) Alex to add `trace_component_tag` flag and rollout plan. 3) Priya to wire daily regression job and publish thresholds. 4) Mark to add eval dataset link to the job.

Alex: I'll open a PR for the flag — pinging @Sam for review. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/2345

Sam: Reviewing today. Also, can folks drop any perf profiles (flamegraphs / perf traces) from the latest p95 spike here? We had a 15% p95 bump last Wed and I want to correlate.

Mark: Uploaded two artifacts to the run artifacts bucket: `gs://redwood-perf/1793/flare-2026-03-10.tar.gz` and `gs://redwood-perf/1793/kvcache-profile-0309.svg`.

Priya: I'll wire the regression job to fetch those artifacts and attach to the alert context.

Jia: Small UX ask — on the console TTFT card, add a small info tooltip that says: "TTFT includes server queue + dynamic batching wait; excludes client network latency". I can draft the copy.

Sam: Great. If no objections, I'll merge the doc PR after Jia's copy and then we can flip the flag in staging tomorrow.

Alex: No objections, go for it. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: note: rollout window detected 0200-0400 UTC. Proposed staging flip at 0300 UTC tomorrow.

Sam: Locking this thread as the coordination plan. Thanks everyone — post updates in this thread if anything blocks.
